#   - drop cases with more than 12 scalars (bounded per-case work);
#   - drop cases containing a scalar assigned after UCD 16.0.0, because
#     `unicode-bidi` 0.3.18 ships UCD 16.0.0 bidi classes (age data from
#     DerivedAge-18.0.0.txt, sha256 58b04334e3a31f9612694bbc3f6bff4a302b7d424565bca9c47e30aa74f8dbac);
#   - keep every case using an explicit bidi formatting scalar, then take a
#     deterministic stride of 31 over the rest, capped at 3000 cases.

# `unicode-bidi` bump cannot silently change coverage.
